claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house and different places
claims.evidence: The witness only reports seeing IBC-style plastic tanks and a black water storage tank; it does not confirm prior use, water-only use, or household use.

risks.risk: Not confirmed food-grade/ potable-water safe (could be chemical/industrial grade IBC).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the IBC label/markings showing grade (e.g., food-grade/ potable) and any hazard/chemical markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-potable/unknown-grade IBC (worst case: treated as industrial/possibly not safe for drinking).

risks.risk: Capacity/volume unknown, so value cannot be set accurately.
risks.proof: A photo showing the capacity rating (liters) and/or model/dimensions on the IBC label or stamped on the tank.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the smallest/most common capacity in the market for an IBC with cage (worst case within what’s typical).

risks.risk: Leaks/cracks/warping not fully inspectable from the reported angles.
risks.proof: A full 360° video/clip of the tank body and bottom seam area, plus a close-up of the outlet area and any fittings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing inspection/possible minor repairs (worst case: assume leak risk until proven otherwise).

risks.risk: Tap/valve/spigot condition unknown (could be seized, leaking, missing parts, or damaged).
risks.proof: A close-up photo and short clip showing the tap/spigot fully, including the connection points; ideally a demonstration of opening/closing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as valve/tap not guaranteed working (worst case: assume replacement may be needed).

risks.risk: Lids/caps and accessories not confirmed (missing caps, hoses, or spigots reduce usability).
risks.proof: Photos of the top opening/lid/cap area and a checklist photo of included accessories (spigot, hoses, caps, stands).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst case: assume missing or not included).

risks.risk: Metal cage integrity unknown (bent/weak cage affects safety and transport).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the entire metal cage from multiple angles showing straightness and weld integrity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cage condition uncertain (worst case: assume some bending/repair needed).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the IBC label/markings (grade: food-grade/potable vs chemical/industrial).
Photo showing capacity rating (liters) and any model/part number on the tank.
360° video/clip of the tank body, seams, and bottom area to check cracks/warping.
Close-up and short clip of the outlet tap/spigot showing it is intact and operates (no drips).
Photos of the top opening/lid/cap and confirmation of what accessories are included (caps, hoses, spigots).
Photos of the full metal cage from multiple angles to confirm it is straight and intact.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as IBC-style water storage tanks with metal cages, so it can be priced at its worst case. However, grade, capacity, leak status, and valve condition are not verifiable from the reported images, so the price should reflect those uncertainties.
